ordered_diagnoses: Signet-ring cell carcinoma of the bladder

s1.syndrome_frame: intermittent painless hematuria with passage of clots in an elderly patient with a history of chronic diseases
salient_findings: painless hematuria with passage of clots
polypoidal mass arising from the bladder dome
exophytic solid tumor on the anterior fundal wall of the bladder
adenocarcinoma composed of mucinous and signet-ring cell components
key_facts: no dysuria, frequency, or other lower urinary tract symptoms
serum creatinine and other biochemical parameters within normal limits
transabdominal ultrasonography showed a 2.9 × 2.5 × 2.4 cm polypoidal mass
cystoscopy demonstrated an exophytic solid tumor
